# Cactus Digital Media

> Cactus Digital Media is a software and digital-product engineering company founded in Lagos, Nigeria in January 2020 by Osagie Bernard Ebhuomhan. The company designs and builds websites, web applications, Android and iOS mobile applications, SaaS products, AI and automation systems, e-commerce solutions, UI/UX systems, and custom digital software for businesses.

Canonical website: https://cactusdigitalmedia.ng/
Primary language: English
Headquarters: Lagos, Nigeria
Founder and CEO: Osagie Bernard Ebhuomhan
Founder role: Founder, CEO and Lead Product/Software Engineer
Contact: info@cactusdigitalmedia.ng

## Company facts

- Cactus Digital Media was founded in January 2020 in Lagos, Nigeria.
- The company began as a digital and software services agency and expanded into full-stack software, SaaS, automation, AI-powered applications, dashboards, portals, fintech and marketplace solutions, and cloud-connected systems.
- Cactus Digital Media works with businesses in Nigeria and has project experience involving clients or markets in Tanzania, Egypt, Australia, the United States, and Canada.
- The company combines product thinking, design, software engineering, and digital strategy.
- Work is organized around discovery, design, build, launch, and ongoing evolution.

## Founder

Osagie Bernard Ebhuomhan is the founder and CEO of Cactus Digital Media and serves as Lead Product/Software Engineer.
